baseline_domains: The original -pid signed INTMIN case and impossible int-count overflow are C undefined domains, not newly claimed defined behavior. No added PID/liveness filtering or permission policy. PID reuse between enumeration and recursive delivery retains original behavior; no new process holds.
effects: Use actual73-bucket ProcessHash/Process/Thread/SigInfo ABI, recorded reader IRQ-lock endpoints and real node storage; owned heap token/extent. Recursive do_kill endpoint controlled after ALL locks released. No raw IRQ/IPI/signal process mutation.
ordering: Each lock/unlock uses same live64-byte aligned stack node; no allocation/recursive call under bucket locks; numeric PIDs only retained after unlock; original request/info/caller borrowed throughout; free exact original heap once, self-only freeNULL unchanged.
scenarios: no matching group→ESRCH after exactly73 balanced first-pass locks
self-only group→one self-last recursive call and free(NULL), no allocation/second scan
matching group peers+self→self always delivered last
pid-1 selects every bucket regardless process pgid
table shrink between passes→only n collected PIDs delivered
table growth between passes→cap first nr_pids, no overflow
caller newly visible in second pass→sendself remembered
recursive return low32 conversion including highbits/INTMIN/-1 and mixed successes/errors; last result wins
scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
